The Echovald Wilds.name: Lighting the Echovald Wilds
The Echovald Wilds.description: Do not light the lanterns because they need to be lit, but because joy is found in bringing light into the world.

The Echovald Wilds.name: Raptor Runner: Echovald Wilds
The Echovald Wilds.description: The descendants of the Kurzicks pride themselves on having such fine control over their mounts as to be able to execute perfectly timed jumps.

The Echovald Wilds.name: Saboteur in Our Midst
The Echovald Wilds.description: How well can you pass for a mad scientist bent on world domination?

The Echovald Wilds.name: The Haunted Altar
The Echovald Wilds.description: Victims of the Ministry of Purity's purge of Echovald, these Canthan spirits attack anyone who comes close. Defeat them to end their pain and usher them finally on to the afterlife.

The Echovald Wilds.name: The Haunted Court
The Echovald Wilds.description: Spirits of fallen members of the Ministry of Purity haunt the Court of Song, so consumed by hatred that they continue to terrorize even after their own deaths. Send them to whatever gods might still have them.

The Echovald Wilds.name: The Haunted Perch
The Echovald Wilds.description: Many tengu sacrificed their lives to overcome the Ministry of Purity. So tortured by the horrors their people had endured, their spirits persisted, unable to tell the difference between friend and foe. Release them finally to the Sky Above Sky.

The Echovald Wilds.name: To Greater Heights
The Echovald Wilds.description: Though they lie shattered and broken, they may yet recover an ounce of their lost glory.

The Echovald Wilds.name: What Did the Shrine Guardians Say?

Seitung Province.description: If your raptor isn't a strong swimmer, try navigating some low, mountainous terrain.

Seitung Province.name: Hatchery Helper
Seitung Province.description: Thanks to your help, these fish will get a chance at an "Extra Life."

Seitung Province.name: Illuminating Seitung Province
Seitung Province.description: May each lantern you light spark happiness within you, not only in the completion of the task, but through the act of lighting the world.

Seitung Province.name: Jumping Training
Seitung Province.description: You will jump up to that platform every day so that it becomes second nature. From there, you'll find even higher places to jump. Do this, and one day, you'll look down and realize how far you've come.

Seitung Province.name: Purist Shenanigans
Seitung Province.description: Nothing ruins the ambience of a place quite like unhinged xenophobia. Deal with the Purists to make Shing Jea great and bigot-free again.

Seitung Province.name: Seitung Harbor Shenanigans
Seitung Province.description: Harbors are the temporal crossroads where life on land intersects life at sea. They remind us that existence, though often viewed in fragments, is of one whole.

Seitung Province.name: Seitung Prison Springer Ride
Seitung Province.description: While springers excel at high jumping, taking the high road isn't always their best route.

Seitung Province.name: Seitung Province Mastery

The Desolation.name: Cleansing Tormented Remnants

The Desolation.description: One of the last remaining vestiges of Abaddon's power is his abiding hatred of dance.

The Desolation.name: Joko's Hidden Chamber
The Desolation.description: Joko has sealed away an important part of his kingdom beneath the shattered ravines near the Bone Palace.

The Desolation.name: Junundu Whisperer

The Desolation.name: Path of the Gods

The Desolation.description: The Forged open realm portals at Maws within the Ruptured Heart to get reinforcement squads. The residue from emerging units can be combined with portal spikes to damage the realm portals.

The Desolation.name: Shadow Patroller
The Desolation.description: Redeemer Kossan—a descendant of Sunspears Koss and Melonni—launches patrols from Torment's Watch, the Order of Shadows camp.

The Desolation.name: Shadow Sprinter
The Desolation.description: Shadows handlers collect intel reports and use them to evaluate enemy and ally positions, then they pass their revised orders to Shadows watchers who distribute the new field orders to agents.

The Desolation.name: Shadow of a Shadow
The Desolation.description: To earn this title, one must prove their commitment to freeing Elona by aiding the Order of Shadows.

The Desolation.name: The Throne of Bones
The Desolation.description: Palawa Joko's throne of bones lies deep within the Bone Palace. His builders aren't very creative...

Crystal Oasis.name: A Trip Down Memory Lane

Crystal Oasis.name: Race to the Finish: Crystal Oasis
Up in Arms
Crystal Oasis.description: One step closer to your own private army.

Crystal Desert.name: Crystal Desert Explorer
Crystal Desert.description: You've explored all major areas of the Crystal Desert.

Crystal Desert.name: Expert Bounty Hunter
Crystal Desert.description: No beast escapes once you're on the hunt.

Crystal Desert.description: You'll take any job, no matter how big or small.

Crystal Desert.name: Master Bounty Hunter
Crystal Desert.description: Songs will be written of your heroic exploits someday.

Elon Riverlands.name: Flameseeker Prophecies

Elon Riverlands.description: Jimoh's family was torn when her husband Iweh spoke against Joko. She is looking for some peace in the aftermath.

Elon Riverlands.name: Frequent Forgotten Teleporter
Elon Riverlands.description: Forgotten teleporters have been in the Crystal Desert for centuries, aiding adventurers' travel across gaps and steep terrain.

Elon Riverlands.name: Ghostly Trio
Elon Riverlands.description: Centuries ago, three heroes guided the Chosen through the Trials of Ascension. When Augury Rock is compromised, they will journey to the Throne of Pellentia to meet their leader, Turai Ossa.

Elon Riverlands.name: Prison Breaker
Elon Riverlands.description: Villagers who don't meet their farming quotas are taken to the Deadhouse, where Warden Jabari turns them into Awakened.

Legendary Weapons.name: Astralaria I: The Device
Legendary Weapons.description: The saying goes—the history of Tyria is written in the stars, and indeed the tales of the past and hints of the future are inscribed in the heavens. Help Ogden Stonehealer in revealing and gathering ancient knowledge in your quest to create the Device, the first of the precursors to the legendary axe Astralaria.

Legendary Weapons.name: Astralaria II: The Apparatus
Legendary Weapons.description: Your first attempt at crafting the legendary precursor The Mechanism has been modestly successful but has not yet yielded the weapon you ultimately desire. This journey has only just begun. Find a teacher, research your procedures, and hone your skills before you try a second time.

Legendary Weapons.name: Astralaria III: The Mechanism
Legendary Weapons.description: The heavens grant their gifts to Tyria in the form of meteors that streak across our skies. Gather the ore of these fallen stars and use it to craft the spinning armillary that will eventually rest in the heart of your legendary weapon. Do this to create The Mechanism, the next step of your quest to attain Astralaria.

Legendary Weapons.name: Astralaria IV: The Cosmos
Legendary Weapons.description: The heavens have aligned to support you in your quest! Chart their places within the heavens to discern their wisdom, and defeat the Elder Dragons and their spawn that threaten the world. Complete these tasks, and earn the Gift of the Cosmos, the penultimate step in attaining the legendary axe known as Astralaria.

Legendary Weapons.name: Bolt I: The Experimental Sword
Legendary Weapons.description: Tyria's finest sword wielders are pure artists, deftly weaving traditional attacks with inspirational lightning maneuvers to create a deadly dance of steel. Consider the art and artisanship of Tyria as you take the first steps in your crafting of the legendary precursor Zap.

Legendary Weapons.name: Bolt II: The Perfected Sword
Legendary Weapons.description: Your first attempt at crafting the legendary precursor Zap has been modestly successful but has not yet yielded the weapon you ultimately desire. This journey has only just begun. Find a teacher, research your procedures, and hone your skills before you try a second time.

Legendary Weapons.name: Bolt III: Zap
Legendary Weapons.description: Brilliance strikes like a bolt from the blue, and that electric shock of imagination applies to both wielding and crafting the mightiest of weapons. Gather the energies of Tyria to infuse them into a superior weapon in your journey to craft the legendary precursor Zap.

Legendary Weapons.name: Chuka and Champawat I: Hunter's Journal
Legendary Weapons.description: "Under Bagred's tutelage, I now undertake my hunt. These pages will chronicle the greatness of my deed."

Legendary Weapons.name: Chuka and Champawat I: The Hunt
Legendary Weapons.description: Great game is what makes a great hunt, and few beasts are greater than the ferocious tiger. Sightings of such a creature have been made around Tyria. With a veteran hunter's tutelage, this glorious hunt could be yours.

Legendary Weapons.name: Chuka and Champawat II: Ambush
Legendary Weapons.description: Your first attempt to craft the legendary precursor Tigris has been modestly successful, but it has not yet yielded the weapon you ultimately desire. This journey has only just begun. Find a teacher, research your procedures, and hone your skills before you try a second time.

Legendary Weapons.name: Chuka and Champawat III: Naturalist's Journal
Legendary Weapons.description: "I set out again with Cymbel as my guide, this time to understand. I now want these pages to capture not my greatness, but the greatness of the creature I pursued."

Legendary Weapons.name: Chuka and Champawat III: Tigris
Legendary Weapons.description: What set the tigers on their mysterious rampage? Were they simply crazed beasts, or is there a deeper story? Seek out the naturalist Cymbel for answers.

Legendary Weapons.name: Chuka and Champawat IV: A Nontraditional Family
Legendary Weapons.description: "Family isn't defined by blood or a shared name. They're who we go to when everything's against us, and we know they'll be there for us for no reason other than we're us."

Legendary Weapons.name: Chuka and Champawat IV: Baby Book
Legendary Weapons.description: "This book is a record of the times my tiger cubs and I shared."

Legendary Weapons.name: Chuka and Champawat IV: Secluded Tour
Legendary Weapons.description: There must be somewhere in Tyria where tigers can live in peace.

Legendary Weapons.name: Chuka and Champawat IV: Tiger Training Guide
Legendary Weapons.description: "As my tigers grow, it's a daily challenge to learn for myself the lessons I need to be able to impart to the cubs when they're ready."

Legendary Weapons.name: Frenzy I: The Experimental Harpoon Gun
Legendary Weapons.description: Fishing in Tyria is no pleasant day spent safely on the shore, waiting for a fish to take the bait. It is fought on the fish's home turf, a battle of fisherman against fish. And the fish fight back. Consider this as you take your first steps in crafting the legendary precursor Rage.

Legendary Weapons.name: Frenzy II: The Perfected Harpoon Gun
Legendary Weapons.description: Your first attempt at crafting the legendary precursor Rage has been modestly successful but has not yet yielded the weapon you ultimately desire. This journey has only just begun. Find a teacher, research your procedures, and hone your skills before you try a second time.

Legendary Weapons.name: Frenzy III: Rage
Legendary Weapons.description: Quaggans are a peaceful people, but when provoked, quaggans become engines of anger and fury. Usually, though, quaggans like friends. Quaggans want give them friendship bracelets. Will you be quaggans' friend? Consider your reply carefully as you seek to attain the legendary precursor Rage.

Legendary Weapons.name: Frostfang I: The Experimental Axe
Legendary Weapons.description: The power of Jormag and the other Elder Dragons seeped into the lands of Tyria during the long epochs while they slept. Upwellings of this power may be found throughout the land, for those who know where to look and how to capture it. Let finding this power be the first part of your journey to craft the legendary precursor Tooth of Frostfang.

Legendary Weapons.name: Frostfang II: The Perfected Axe
Legendary Weapons.description: Your first attempt at crafting the legendary precursor Tooth of Frostfang has been modestly successful but has not yet yielded the weapon you ultimately desire. This journey has only just begun. Find a teacher, research your procedures, and hone your skills before you try a second time.

Legendary Weapons.name: Frostfang III: Tooth of Frostfang
Legendary Weapons.description: Within the halls of the norn hang the Fang of the Serpent, a fragment of the great ice Elder Dragon. Frostfang was the greatest of Jormag's champions, and Asgeir Dragonrender slayed Frostfang with but a single blow. Channel this power over ice into your efforts to create the legendary precursor Tooth of Frostfang.

Legendary Weapons.name: HOPE I: Research
Legendary Weapons.description: The froglike hylek are Tyria's best alchemists, the masters of potion and poison. Take the role of the apprentice in discovering the secrets of their work to create research, the first step in attaining the Hylek Optimized Projectile Experiment (HOPE).

Legendary Weapons.name: HOPE II: Development
Legendary Weapons.description: Your first attempt at crafting the legendary precursor Prototype has been modestly successful but has not yet yielded the weapon you ultimately desire. This journey has only just begun. Find a teacher, research your procedures, and hone your skills before you try a second time.

Legendary Weapons.name: HOPE III: Prototype
Legendary Weapons.description: As the hylek are masters of alchemy, so too are the asura the wizards of technomagical research. They understand the forces in play in their Eternal Alchemy and how to apply them to the greater world. Uncover their secrets in your work to attain Prototype, the next step in your legendary journey for attaining HOPE.

Legendary Weapons.name: HOPE IV: The Catalyst
Legendary Weapons.description: Let magical energy and alchemical potions combine as you bring the energies of asura and hylek together to create and charge a more perfect weapon, gaining the Gift of the Catalyst, the penultimate step in your journey to gain HOPE, the legendary pistol.

Legendary Weapons.name: Howler I: The Experimental Warhorn
Legendary Weapons.description: You hear their cries on the wind in the mountain valleys and the far places of the world. They are the wolves, fierce as individuals, and united as a pack. Consider their combined power as you channel the wolf's hunting spirit in your initial steps to attack the legendary precursor, Howl.

Legendary Weapons.name: Howler II: The Perfected Warhorn
Legendary Weapons.description: Your first attempt at crafting the legendary precursor Howl has been modestly successful but has not yet yielded the weapon you ultimately desire. This journey has only just begun. Find a teacher, research your procedures, and hone your skills before you try a second time.

Legendary Weapons.name: Howler III: Howl
Legendary Weapons.description: Ghosts. Shades. Spirits of the Wild. They exist within our world and somewhere else as well, insubstantial, yet powerful. Meditate upon their nature in your journey to craft the legendary precursor known as Howl.

Legendary Weapons.name: Incinerator I: The Experimental Dagger
Legendary Weapons.description: From the heart of the furnace, the elements dance and caper at your command! Many rare and unusual elements are needed for your journey, and you must capture and comprehend them all in order to take your first steps in creating the legendary precursor Spark.

Legendary Weapons.name: Incinerator II: The Perfected Dagger
Legendary Weapons.description: Your first attempt at crafting the legendary precursor Spark has been modestly successful but has not yet yielded the weapon you ultimately desire. This journey has only just begun. Find a teacher, research your procedures, and hone your skills before you try a second time.

Legendary Weapons.name: Incinerator III: Spark
Legendary Weapons.description: Natural materials are the foundations of understanding, but creative alchemy requires creations unlike those found in the natural world. Gather these unnatural materials in your efforts to forge the legendary precursor Spark.

Legendary Weapons.name: Kamohoali'i Kotaki I: The Experimental Spear
Legendary Weapons.description: They move through the sea, silent and remorseless. They are respected and feared for their unrelenting savagery. They are sharks. Consider the place of these great beasts in the world, for good and ill, as you take your first steps in creating the legendary precursor known as Carcharias.

Legendary Weapons.name: Kamohoali'i Kotaki II: The Perfected Spear
Legendary Weapons.description: Your first attempt at crafting the legendary precursor Carcharias has been modestly successful but has not yet yielded the weapon you ultimately desire. This journey has only just begun. Find a teacher, research your procedures, and hone your skills before you try a second time.

Legendary Weapons.name: Kamohoali'i Kotaki III: Carcharias
Legendary Weapons.description: The sea is wide and mighty, and conceals both great dangers and wondrous prizes. Dive into it, explore its depths, and swim deep beneath its ever-shifting surface in your journey to create the legendary precursor known as Carcharias.

Legendary Weapons.name: Kraitkin I: The Experimental Trident
Legendary Weapons.description: Versatile, flexible, and strong; tentacles invoke a feeling of strangeness and otherworldliness. Meditate on the virtues of such tentacled beasts as wind riders and jellyfish as you take your first steps in attaining the legendary precursor Venom.

Legendary Weapons.name: Kraitkin II: The Perfected Trident
Legendary Weapons.description: Your first attempt at crafting the legendary precursor Venom has been modestly successful but has not yet yielded the weapon you ultimately desire. This journey has only just begun. Find a teacher, research your procedures, and hone your skills before you try a second time.

Legendary Weapons.name: Kraitkin III: Venom
Legendary Weapons.description: The krait are the monsters of the deep—vile, violent, and totally evil. Their slave-raiding parties roam the beaches, and their towers rise from the depths of the sea. Battle these malevolent masters of the ocean in your journey to craft the legendary precursor Venom.

Legendary Weapons.name: Kudzu I: The Experimental Longbow
Legendary Weapons.description: Through flood, fire, and famine, the power of the plants survive. The story of its resilience and quiet power can be found in every root and stem, in every petal and leaf. Meditate on the power of such things as you begin your journey to create the legendary precursor, Leaf of Kudzu.

Legendary Weapons.name: Kudzu II: The Perfected Longbow
Legendary Weapons.description: Your first attempt at crafting the legendary precursor Leaf of Kudzu has been modestly successful but has not yet yielded the weapon you ultimately desire. This journey has only just begun. Find a teacher, research your procedures, and hone your skills before you try a second time.

Legendary Weapons.name: Kudzu III: Leaf of Kudzu
Legendary Weapons.description: Within sight of a great volcano lies a hidden garden that you must make your own. Tame and raise the plants within this hidden garden to master their secrets, channeling that power into your efforts to create the legendary precursor Leaf of Kudzu.

Legendary Weapons.name: Legendary Sigil Collector
Legendary Weapons.description: A true commander needs a sigil for every day of the week.

Legendary Weapons.name: Legendary Weapon: Klobjarne Geirr
Legendary Weapons.description: Note: If this achievement is completed before Journey of the Claw is progressed, loading into Lowland Shore will update the achievement if applicable.

Legendary Weapons.name: Meteorlogicus I: The Experimental Scepter
Legendary Weapons.description: The power of the elements are some of the greatest powers in Tyria. Journey through the land and experience the fury of its storms and the might of its creatures as you begin your personal journey to create the legendary precursor Storm.

Legendary Weapons.name: Meteorlogicus II: The Perfected Scepter
Legendary Weapons.description: Your first attempt at crafting the legendary precursor Storm has been modestly successful but has not yet yielded the weapon you ultimately desire. This journey has only just begun. Find a teacher, research your procedures, and hone your skills before you try a second time.

Legendary Weapons.name: Meteorlogicus III: Storm
Legendary Weapons.description: Power, regardless of origin, is only of use when it is properly mastered, and to control the elements, one must understand the nature of control itself. Consider the nature of control, those who control, and those who are controlled, in your quest to attain the legendary precursor Storm.

Legendary Weapons.name: Nevermore I: Ravenswood Branch
Legendary Weapons.description: The bounty of Tyria's nature is immense but not without limit, and as such must be cultivated, encouraged, and most of all protected. Get in touch with nature of Tyria in your quest to create the Ravenswood Branch, the first of the precursors to the legendary staff, Nevermore.

Legendary Weapons.name: Nevermore II: Ravenswood Staff
Legendary Weapons.description: Your first attempt at crafting the legendary precursor The Raven Staff has been modestly successful but has not yet yielded the weapon you ultimately desire. This journey has only just begun. Find a teacher, research your procedures, and hone your skills before you try a second time.

Legendary Weapons.name: Nevermore III: The Raven Staff
Legendary Weapons.description: Tyria is both a physical and a spiritual place, and its hills and forests are alive with ghosts, spirits, and other ethereal creatures. Seek the spirit of the wild raven that haunts its hills and forests. Let it lead you on its path in your quest to attain the Raven Staff, the next step in your quest to attain Nevermore.

Legendary Weapons.name: Nevermore IV: The Raven Spirit
Legendary Weapons.description: Take upon yourself the responsibility of raising a raven from egg to chick to adult, while you work toward taming the wild raven spirit you have already caught. With the blessings of the Great Spirit, Raven, these two are destined to join together, earning you the Gift of the Raven Spirit, the penultimate step to attaining the legendary staff, Nevermore.

Legendary Weapons.name: Quip I: The Experimental Pistol
Legendary Weapons.description: Humor is in the mind of the beholder, and a prankster is welcome everywhere. Well, most places. Well, among your friends. Consider this quirk in the nature of the universe as you take your first steps in creating the legendary precursor the Chaos Gun.

Legendary Weapons.name: Quip II: The Perfected Pistol
Legendary Weapons.description: Your first attempt at crafting the legendary precursor Chaos Gun has been modestly successful but has not yet yielded the weapon you ultimately desire. This journey has only just begun. Find a teacher, research your procedures, and hone your skills before you try a second time.

Legendary Weapons.name: Quip III: Chaos Gun
Legendary Weapons.description: Confetti bombs. Sigils of Mischief. Laughter. Pies. These are the weapons of a master prankster, used to embarrass the mighty and the might-be alike. Master these malicious matters of mischief in your efforts to craft the legendary precursor known as the Chaos Gun.

Legendary Weapons.name: Rodgort I: The Experimental Torch
Legendary Weapons.description: Fire is the most volatile and energetic of the elements. Consign the parts of magical beasts to the flames, and meditate on the flames that result, as you begin your journey to attain the legendary precursor known as Rodgort's Flame.

Legendary Weapons.name: Rodgort II: The Perfected Torch
Legendary Weapons.description: Your first attempt at crafting the legendary precursor Rodgort's Flame has been modestly successful but has not yet yielded the weapon you ultimately desire. This journey has only just begun. Find a teacher, research your procedures, and hone your skills before you try a second time.

Legendary Weapons.name: Rodgort III: Rodgort's Flame
Legendary Weapons.description: Fire provides both heat and light, inflicting burns against the foe and calling attention to itself through its bright, flickering nature. Use the flames for both weal and woe as you attain the legendary precursor Rodgort's Flame.

Legendary Weapons.name: Sunrise I: The Experimental Daysword
Legendary Weapons.description: Tyria is a land filled with peoples worth protecting. Defend the innocent, rescue the threatened, and consider your role as a hero in order to take your first steps in creating the legendary precursor Dawn.

Legendary Weapons.name: Sunrise II: The Perfected Daysword
Legendary Weapons.description: Your first attempt at crafting the legendary precursor Dawn has been modestly successful but has not yet yielded the weapon you ultimately desire. This journey has only just begun. Find a teacher, research your procedures, and hone your skills before you try a second time.

Legendary Weapons.name: Sunrise III: Dawn
Legendary Weapons.description: A shining light of a new day reveals all and banishes the darkness to the deeper haunts of Tyria. Use your crafted Illuminator to gather the light throughout the land in your journey to create the legendary precursor known as Dawn.

Legendary Weapons.name: The Bifrost I: The Experimental Staff
Legendary Weapons.description: The Jotun Star, fabled relic of the ancient mystical race, was said to call down a rainbow to the land. The stone, and its power, was broken long ago. Help bring it to rest as the first part of your journey to craft the legendary precursor The Legend.

Legendary Weapons.name: The Bifrost II: The Perfected Staff
Legendary Weapons.description: Your first attempt at crafting the legendary precursor The Legend has been modestly successful but has not yet yielded the weapon you ultimately desire. This journey has only just begun. Find a teacher, research your procedures, and hone your skills before you try a second time.

Legendary Weapons.name: The Bifrost III: The Legend
Legendary Weapons.description: Light shines upon the world, creating the colors around us. Study and create the color palette of the world using artistry and light. Channel this rainbow into your efforts to craft the legendary precursor The Legend.

Legendary Weapons.name: The Dreamer I: The Experimental Short Bow
Legendary Weapons.description: The heart hunts on a lonely train, plagued by desire, sadness, and occasionally joy. It pervades Tyria and its people. Track down these moments of the heart throughout the land in your first steps to create the legendary precursor The Lover.

Legendary Weapons.name: The Dreamer II: The Perfected Short Bow
Legendary Weapons.description: Your first attempt at crafting the legendary precursor The Lover has been modestly successful but has not yet yielded the weapon you ultimately desire. This journey has only just begun. Find a teacher, research your procedures, and hone your skills before you try a second time.

Legendary Weapons.name: The Dreamer III: The Lover
Legendary Weapons.description: Desire leads to dreams, and the passions of the heart to the yearnings of the soul. Some dreams are bright, some are dark, some are for things lost, and some are for things yet to be. Gather these fragments of dreams and desires to channel into your efforts to create the legendary precursor known as The Lover.

Legendary Weapons.name: The Flameseeker Prophecies I: The Experimental Shield
Legendary Weapons.description: Tyria is a land of heroes and villains locked in eternal struggle. Attain the "Anthology of Villains," and record the tales of the defeat of the most dastardly of their lot. Meditate upon the nature of villainy as you take the first steps in creating the legendary precursor known as The Chosen.

Legendary Weapons.name: The Flameseeker Prophecies II: The Perfected Shield
Legendary Weapons.description: Your first attempt at crafting the legendary precursor The Chosen has been modestly successful but has not yet yielded the weapon you ultimately desire. This journey has only just begun. Find a teacher, research your procedures, and hone your skills before you try a second time.

Legendary Weapons.name: The Flameseeker Prophecies III: The Chosen
Legendary Weapons.description: Tyria is a land of heroes and villains locked in eternal struggle. Attain the "Anthology of Heroes," and record the tales of the greatest of their number, both from the past and the heroes of today. Consider the true nature of heroism in your efforts to craft the legendary precursor known as The Chosen.

Legendary Weapons.name: The Juggernaut I: The Experimental Hammer
Legendary Weapons.description: The wonders of the stone and soil, carved by nature and by sentient races, exude both power and stability. Meditate on these great places in order to take your first steps in creating the legendary precursor known as The Colossus.

Legendary Weapons.name: The Juggernaut II: The Perfected Hammer
Legendary Weapons.description: Your first attempt at crafting the legendary precursor The Colossus has been modestly successful but has not yet yielded the weapon you ultimately desire. This journey has only just begun. Find a teacher, research your procedures, and hone your skills before you try a second time.

Legendary Weapons.name: The Juggernaut III: The Colossus
Legendary Weapons.description: The power of the earth is not only in its strength but in its fluid nature, moving slowly as stone should not move. Collect and bond with the oozes that live in the heart of the world to solve their mysteries and create the legendary precursor The Colossus.

Legendary Weapons.name: The Minstrel I: The Experimental Focus
Legendary Weapons.description: Which came first, the critic or the egg? It is hard to tell, but the former seems to be well armed with the latter. Comprehend the nature of these critical missiles in order to take your first steps in creating the legendary precursor The Bard.

Legendary Weapons.name: The Minstrel II: The Perfected Focus
Legendary Weapons.description: Your first attempt at crafting the legendary precursor The Bard has been modestly successful but has not yet yielded the weapon you ultimately desire. This journey has only just begun. Find a teacher, research your procedures, and hone your skills before you try a second time.

Legendary Weapons.name: The Minstrel III: The Bard
Legendary Weapons.description: From the forge of criticism emerges the glory of performance, where one learns of the vast wonder of the world of music. Tyria is alive with music if one only takes the time to focus upon it. Gather these songs in your journey to create the legendary precursor The Bard.

Legendary Weapons.name: The Moot I: The Experimental Mace
Legendary Weapons.description: First comes the hunt—the matching of martial prowess against the bestial cunning. Mighty creatures roam the land, and as you stalk them, consider their place, in these initial steps to creating the legendary precursor known as The Energizer. Hurry! Before someone gets eaten!

Legendary Weapons.name: The Moot II: The Perfected Mace
Legendary Weapons.description: Your first attempt at crafting the legendary precursor The Energizer has been modestly successful but has not yet yielded the weapon you ultimately desire. This journey has only just begun. Find a teacher, research your procedures, and hone your skills before you try a second time.

Legendary Weapons.name: The Moot III: The Energizer
Legendary Weapons.description: After the successful hunt comes the celebration, when all the pent-up energy of the battle is released in food and song. Drink, dine, dance, and revel across the land of Tyria in your journey to attain the legendary precursor known as the Energizer.

Legendary Weapons.name: The Predator I: The Experimental Rifle
Legendary Weapons.description: The rifle, whether it fires bullets or magical rays, is one of the most complex common weapons of Tyria. Understand its wonders by researching the technology of such weapons as you take your first steps in the personal journey to create the legendary precursor known as The Hunter.

Legendary Weapons.name: The Predator II: The Perfected Rifle
Legendary Weapons.description: Your first attempt at crafting the legendary precursor The Hunter has been modestly successful but has not yet yielded the weapon you ultimately desire. This journey has only just begun. Find a teacher, research your procedures, and hone your skills before you try a second time.

Legendary Weapons.name: The Predator III: The Hunter
Legendary Weapons.description: One hunts by stealth and slyness, and one targets only the most valuable prey. Show your ability to stalk your prey and use the knowledge gained as you craft the legendary precursor The Hunter.

Legendary Weapons.name: Twilight I: The Experimental Nightsword
Legendary Weapons.description: All things must end, all kingdoms must perish, and every day must finish in the fall of night. Consider the finality of all things by meditating on the transience of power and glory throughout Tyria, all in order to take your first steps in creating the legendary precursor known as Dusk.

Legendary Weapons.name: Twilight II: The Perfected Nightsword
Legendary Weapons.description: Your first attempt at crafting the legendary precursor Dusk has been modestly successful but has not yet yielded the weapon you ultimately desire. This journey has only just begun. Find a teacher, research your procedures, and hone your skills before you try a second time.

Legendary Weapons.name: Twilight III: Dusk
Legendary Weapons.description: It is always darkest before the dawn, and within that gloom lies great potential and power. Use your crafted Gloominator to pull the gloom from the land in your journey to create the legendary precursor Dusk.

Legendary Backpacks.name: Ad Infinitum I: Finite Result
Legendary Backpacks.description: Unlock all 11 fractal components to work towards building the legendary fractal backpack.

Legendary Backpacks.name: Ad Infinitum II: Upper Bound
Legendary Backpacks.description: Unlock all 11 fractal tier 2 components to work towards building the legendary fractal backpack.

Legendary Backpacks.name: Ad Infinitum III: Unbound
Legendary Backpacks.description: Unlock all 11 fractal tier 3 components to work towards building the legendary fractal backpack.

Legendary Backpacks.name: Legendary Backpack: Ad Infinitum
Legendary Backpacks.description: Unlock all 13 fractal tier 4 components to work towards building the legendary fractal backpack.

Legendary Armor.name: A Legendary Path: Astral Gifts
Legendary Armor.description: This collection can be a useful reference to what's needed for each gift. You may need multiples of some of these items.

Legendary Armor.name: Acquiring Agaleus
Legendary Armor.description: It's not just the "captain's" story that's fishy...

Legendary Armor.name: Envoy Armor I: Experimental Armor
Legendary Armor.description: The envoys shepherd the souls of the dead to their place in the Underworld. By studying spiritual energy, you may learn their secrets and start your journey toward building a truly legendary set of armor.

Legendary Armor.name: Envoy Armor II: Refined Armor
Legendary Armor.description: To improve your Envoy Armor, it will take an incredible amount of aspected magical energy collected from across Tyria and the Mists.

Legendary Armor.name: Legendary Armorer
Legendary Armor.description: Owner of some of the rarest items in Tyria.

Legendary Armor.name: Legendary Rune Collector
Legendary Armor.description: You feel a new bounce in your step now that you don't have to carry so many runes around.

Legendary Armor.name: That's Quality Armor
Legendary Armor.description: "Thank you so much. Take a look."

Legendary Armor.name: Tier 2 Legendary Armor: Suffused Obsidian
Legendary Armor.description: "Now, what if I told you I could add some panache to that ensemble?"—Conri

Legendary Trinkets.name: Coalescence I: Unbridled
Legendary Trinkets.description: Your predilection for violence has attracted the attention of malevolent energy. Perhaps you can soothe its bloodlust somehow.

Legendary Trinkets.name: Coalescence II: The Gift
Legendary Trinkets.description: Its bloodlust somewhat lessened, your energy friend now desires to learn more about being. Also it wants a name.

Legendary Trinkets.name: Coalescence III: Culmination
Legendary Trinkets.description: Your energy friend is keenly interested in your decisions.

Legendary Trinkets.name: Helping Hylek: Kill Krait
Legendary Trinkets.description: The Eztlitl have been plagued by the krait for long enough.

Legendary Trinkets.name: Legendary Relic Collector
Legendary Trinkets.description: Who needs Archivist Ikur when you have this?

Legendary Trinkets.name: Legendary Relics: Components
Legendary Trinkets.description: This collection can be a useful reference to what's needed for each gift. You may need multiples of some of these items.

Legendary Trinkets.name: Radiance of the Sun God
Legendary Trinkets.description: "And then Zintl gifted the hylek with endless summers, filled with warmth and guiding light. May the sun never set."

Legendary Trinkets.name: Vision I: Awakening
Legendary Trinkets.description: Breathe deeply and open all three of your eyes.

Legendary Trinkets.name: Vision II: Farsight
Legendary Trinkets.description:
Can you see past the void?

Note: Only Mastery Insights in Living World Season 4 are required for this achievement.

Legendary Trinkets.name: Visions of Dragonfall
Legendary Trinkets.description:
Crashing to the earth, cleaving the Mists...

Note: Completion of this achievement requires completion of the Riding Skyscales achievement.

Legendary Trinkets.name: Visions of Istan
Legendary Trinkets.description:
Istan stinks of death and deception only to those who fail to see...

Note: Completion of this achievement requires completion of the Riding Skyscales achievements.

Legendary Trinkets.name: Visions of Jahai
Legendary Trinkets.description:
What is time to one who transcends it?

Note: Completion of this achievement requires completion of the Riding Skyscales achievement.

Legendary Trinkets.name: Visions of Kourna
Legendary Trinkets.description:
Eternal life, either blessing or curse, squandered by greed and the thirst for power.

Note: Completion of this achievement requires completion of the Riding Skyscales achievement.

Legendary Trinkets.name: Visions of Sandswept Isles
Legendary Trinkets.description:
Sandswept Isles, where the shortsighted seek immediate power and knowledge.

Note: Completion of this achievement requires completion of the Riding Skyscales achievements.

Legendary Trinkets.name: Visions of Thunderhead Peaks
Legendary Trinkets.description:
Vision and visions, ended together in time...

Note: Completion of this achievement requires completion of the Riding Skyscales achievement.

Festival Collections.name: For the Children!
Festival Collections.description: Find the ornaments that the wicked Grawnk stole from the orphans. Completing this grants you a Wintersday Gift Tree in your home instance!

Festival Collections.name: Mad Armory: Carapace of Chaos
Festival Collections.description: The storehouses of the Mad Realm contain many artifacts crafted by the Lunatic Court at their king's behest. Although tales of the Shell of Insanity have spread, its descendant works have remained forgotten—until now.

Festival Collections.name: Mad Armory: Last Rites
Festival Collections.description: An offhanded whim of Mad King Thorn, made a reality by his zealous court. Executioner's tool and tombstone in one, this sword was intended for use on the king's rivals. Then as a loyal adherent of the king, are you not are an appropriate wielder?
